terms.meaning: game title
terms.reason: brand; no official localized title given
terms.notes: Translators mark keep:true on the title key.

terms.meaning: Roblox's premium currency
terms.reason: Roblox keeps it in every language
terms.notes: Never translated or replaced with a symbol.

terms.meaning: keyboard key in sell.prompt
terms.notes: Translate the words around it.

terms.meaning: example promo code players type in the codes box
terms.notes: Not in the table text; it appears only in the developer note for codes.enter. No promo code is ever translated.

terms.meaning: invented glowing eel, the game's mascot fish
terms.reason: ordinary words that tell players what the fish is; but as the mascot it may appear in thumbnails and ads, where an English name keeps the brand
terms.notes: If translated, keep the idea of a glowing lantern. Non-Latin locales that keep it follow their guide on transliteration. Checkpoint: developer chose translate.

terms.meaning: a fishing spot in the game, named in a quest
terms.reason: descriptive place name players should understand; but in-world signs or map labels may show the English name, which a translation would no longer match
terms.notes: If kept, it must be byte-identical in quest.catch_n. Checkpoint: developer chose translate.

terms.meaning: fish species, a golden-colored carp (a real ornamental fish)
terms.reason: ordinary words for a real fish
terms.notes: Base form (singular, no article); also inserted as {fish} into catch.success.

terms.meaning: rarity tier above Legendary, the highest known
terms.reason: rarity names that are ordinary words are translated
terms.notes: Must read as higher than Legendary; also inserted as {rarity} into catch.success.

terms.meaning: rarity tier just below Mythic
terms.reason: rarity names that are ordinary words are translated
terms.notes: Not in this table; listed so Mythic is rendered as the tier above it.

terms.meaning: rarity tier; also the adjective in 'rare fish' (pass.lucky_bait, ascend.confirm, weather.storm)
terms.reason: rarity names that are ordinary words are translated
terms.notes: Use the same word for the tier and for 'rare fish'.

terms.meaning: prestige: reset rods and coins for a permanent luck bonus
terms.reason: core mechanic; players read it in their language
terms.notes: Not religious and not climbing. Same word in ascend.button and ascend.confirm.

terms.meaning: consumable used to fish; counted on the HUD and given as a reward
terms.notes: Same word in hud.bait_left, group.join and the pass name Lucky Bait.

terms.meaning: soft currency earned by selling fish
stat that raises the chance of rare fish; boosted by friends, Ascend and Lucky Bait
terms.notes: Same word in friends.boost and inside Lucky Bait.

terms.meaning: fishing rods, bought and equipped in the shop
terms.notes: Fishing rods only, not metal rods or poles.

terms.meaning: HUD action: throw the fishing line into the water
terms.notes: Fishing sense, not a spell or a movie cast.

terms.meaning: HUD action: pull the line in while a fish bites
terms.notes: Same verb in the pass name Auto Reel.

terms.meaning: inventory of caught fish, opened from the HUD
tasks that give rewards when claimed
player-to-player exchange of fish or items
terms.notes: Use the word players in your language use for trading on Roblox; same word in trade.sent and trade.accept.

terms.meaning: promo code typed in the codes box for a reward
terms.notes: Translate the word 'code', never the code itself.

terms.meaning: the studio's Roblox group (platform feature)
terms.notes: Use the word Roblox's own UI uses for groups in your language.

terms.meaning: consecutive days of daily login
game pass that reels hooked fish in automatically
terms.reason: pass names that describe what they do are translated, unless the owner wants them identical for marketing
terms.notes: Same verb as Reel. The pass's store name is set separately in Creator Hub and should match. Checkpoint: developer chose translate.

terms.meaning: game pass that doubles the chance of rare fish
terms.reason: pass names that describe what they do are translated, unless the owner wants them identical for marketing
terms.notes: Built from the glossary words luck and Bait. Shown in bold inside pass.lucky_bait. Same answer as Auto Reel. Checkpoint: developer chose translate.
